strings.Langue de webadmin (immédiat) et du text: Language of webadmin (immediate) and of the text shown on screen by the program (the display program is restarted when you save). To add a language, drop a file in the lang folder (see the documentation).
strings.Petits panneaux affichés à côté de chaqu: Small panels shown next to each aircraft on the map. Reorder the items with the arrows, choose which to show, their size, bold and italic, and whether they share the previous item's line. If everything is hidden, no panel is shown. Applied after the program restarts.
strings.Modifier ces valeurs oblige à reconstrui: Changing these values requires rebuilding the map (Map rebuild section, at the bottom of this page).
strings.Le port et l'adresse d'écoute demandent: The port and listening address require a webadmin restart. The username and password apply immediately.
strings.Réglages avancés. Une valeur vide utilis: Advanced settings. An empty value uses the default behavior.
strings.La mise à jour elle-même se lance depuis: The update itself is started from the "Updates" tab.
strings.Les changements sont appliqués immédiate: Changes apply immediately: webadmin reconnects to the MQTT server.
Display order, from top to bottom.
strings.Nécessaire pour construire la carte (lue: Required to build the map (read by build_map_vector.py).
strings.Taille de l'image de fond. Demande de re: Size of the background image. Requires rebuilding the map.
Too low: risk of a 429 error.
strings.Délai entre deux requêtes de détails d'a: Delay between two aircraft detail requests.
Beyond this, the aircraft is removed from the map.
A low value spares the Pi Zero.
strings.0 = pas de limite. Les avions plus hauts: 0 = no limit. Higher aircraft are ignored.
strings.Décochez un angle pour que le panneau n': Untick a corner so the panel is never shown there, even if an aircraft passes behind the other corners. If all are unticked, there is no restriction.
strings.La liste des avions au sol occupe déjà c: The list of aircraft on the ground already occupies this corner when it is shown.
strings.Ex. BOD. Sert à afficher « de ... » et «: E.g. BOD. Used to display "from ..." and "to ...".
strings.Un avion qui disparaît sous cette altitu: An aircraft that disappears below this altitude is considered landed.
strings.Interrupteur général. La coupure tempora: Master switch. Temporary muting is done in Control.
strings.Valeur de départ. Le curseur de Pilotage: Starting value. The slider in Control overrides it live.
strings.Les avions plus bas ne déclenchent pas l: Lower aircraft do not trigger the alert.
strings.Joue le carillon une fois au démarrage,: Plays the chime once at startup, independently of the other options in this section.
strings.Teinte rouge et carillon pendant quelque: Red tint and chime for a few seconds, even if "Sound when the program starts" is unticked.
strings.Vide : aucune protection. Le mot de pass: Empty: no protection. The password travels in clear text on the local network.
strings.Interpréteur du venv, utilisé pour build: Interpreter of the venv, used for build_map_vector.py.
strings.Arrêter l'affichage pendant la construct: Stop the display during the build
Default value of the Map tab.
strings.Interroge GitHub régulièrement pour sign: Checks GitHub regularly to report a new version. Without the automatic installation option below, nothing is installed without your approval.
strings.Délai entre deux interrogations de GitHu: Delay between two queries to GitHub, from 1 to 48 hours.
strings.Dès qu'une nouvelle version est détectée: As soon as a new version is detected, it is installed without any intervention (with an automatic return to the previous version if it fails). The display program is briefly restarted if the update affects it. Requires the automatic check.
strings.Mise à jour lancée automatiquement (opti: Update started automatically ("Install updates automatically" option).
strings.Publie l'état et accepte les commandes d: Publishes the state and accepts commands from Home Assistant.
strings.Certificat vérifié avec les autorités du: Certificate verified with the system authorities.
strings.le caractère % n'est pas autorisé dans c: the % character is not allowed in config.ini
strings.{0} : le caractère % n'est pas autorisé: {0}: the % character is not allowed in config.ini
strings.Arrêt de l'affichage pendant la construc: Stopping the display during the build...

strings.Le programme d'affichage ne reste pas ac: The display program does not stay active with the new version.
strings.Version précédente restaurée et affichag: Previous version restored and display restarted.

strings.affichage arrêté ou en veille : il utili: display stopped or asleep: it will use the new version at its next start
strings.Redémarrage de webadmin pour charger la: Restarting webadmin to load the new version...
strings.Le redémarrage automatique de webadmin a: The automatic restart of webadmin failed ({0}): restart it manually.
strings.Mise à jour appliquée, mais webadmin doi: Update applied, but webadmin must be restarted manually (sudo systemctl restart flightadmin).
strings.Après une extinction, il faut débrancher: After a shutdown, the power supply must be unplugged and plugged back in.
strings.La position ou le rayon de la carte a ch: The position or radius of the map has changed: the map must be rebuilt.
Frees the memory of the Pi Zero.
strings.Enregistrer et relancer le programme et: Save and restart the program and webadmin
strings.L'enregistrement relance le programme d': Saving restarts the display program and webadmin to apply these values.
Saving restarts the display program to apply these values (a few seconds without image on the screen).
strings.L'enregistrement redémarre webadmin pour: Saving restarts webadmin to apply these values (the page will be unavailable for a few seconds).
Applied as soon as you save.
strings.Enregistré, mais pas encore pris en comp: Saved, but not applied yet. Still to do: {0}.
strings.Mettre l'écran en veille ? L'affichage s: Put the screen to sleep? The display will be stopped.
strings.Éteindre le Raspberry Pi ? Il faudra le: Shut down the Raspberry Pi? It will have to be unplugged and plugged back in to turn it on again.
strings.Coupé : icône de haut-parleur barré à l': Muted: crossed-out speaker icon on screen
strings.Carillon à chaque avion entrant dans la: Chime for each aircraft entering the zone
strings.Aucun mot de passe n'est défini : toute: No password is set: anyone on the local network can control the Raspberry Pi. Set one below.
strings.Redémarrer webadmin ? La page sera indis: Restart webadmin? The page will be unavailable for a few seconds.
strings.Associe un code de type d'avion (ICAO) à: Associates an aircraft type code (ICAO) with an icon shape. One rule per line: the code, then the category. Lines starting with # are comments. Applied after the program restarts.
strings.Types inconnus détectés dans les logs: Unknown types detected in the logs
strings.Afficher sur la même ligne que l'élément: Show on the same line as the previous item
strings.Des fichiers du logiciel ont été modifié: Software files have been modified locally ({0}): the update is blocked so nothing is overwritten.
strings.Cette installation contient {0} commit(s: This installation contains {0} local commit(s) missing from GitHub: update impossible without a conflict.
This installation contains {0} local commit(s) missing from GitHub.
strings.Le programme d'installation (install.sh): The installer (install.sh) changed in this version. Webadmin does not update system components: if a new feature does not work, run the installer again.
strings.Télécharge la dernière version depuis Gi: Downloads the latest version from GitHub (arcalulu/flightdisplay repository). Your settings (config.ini) are kept.
strings.Webadmin redémarre, la page va se rechar: Webadmin is restarting, the page will reload...
strings.Le crédit est déjà visible à l'intérieur: The credit is already visible inside the image: this option adds an extra line of text below the photo in the panel. Untick it to hide it.
strings.Flight display s'appuie sur des données,: Flight display relies on third-party data, services and libraries.
strings.Fond de carte vectoriel, affiché en perm: Vector base map, always shown at the bottom right of the screen.
strings.Flightradar24, via la bibliothèque non o: Flightradar24, through the unofficial FlightRadarAPI library. Personal, non-commercial use only.
strings.© leurs auteurs, via JetPhotos. Le crédi: © their authors, through JetPhotos. The photographer's credit is visible inside the image.
strings.Allume et éteint l'écran tout seul selon: Turns the screen on and off by itself following a weekly calendar: drag on the calendar to draw the on ranges. Applied immediately.
strings.Hors des plages d'allumage, l'écran est: Outside the on ranges, the screen is off.
Outside the on ranges, the screen is off. Turning it on or off by hand remains possible: the schedule resumes at the next scheduled time.
strings.Les plages bleues sont les heures où l'é: The blue ranges are the hours when the screen is on. Drag on a day to draw a range (a simple click creates a one-hour one), pull its edges to adjust it, move it to change its time or day, ✕ to delete it. The ⧉ button copies the day to the whole week.
strings.Copier ce jour sur toute la semaine: Copy this day to the whole week
strings.Le planning veut l'écran allumé maintena: The schedule wants the screen on now.
strings.Le planning veut l'écran éteint maintena: The schedule wants the screen off now.
strings.Planning enregistré inactif : l'écran n': Schedule saved but inactive: the screen is not managed automatically.
strings.Prochaine action : allumage demain à {0}: Next action: turn on tomorrow at {0} (in {1})
strings.Prochaine action : extinction demain à {: Next action: turn off tomorrow at {0} (in {1})
strings.Espace disque du Raspberry Pi et photos: Disk space of the Raspberry Pi and JetPhotos photos kept in the cache. The program deletes photos older than 3 days by itself and downloads a deleted photo again when it is needed once more.
strings.Une alerte s'affiche dans webadmin quand: An alert is shown in webadmin when disk usage reaches this percentage (orange alert 10 points earlier).
strings.Libérez de l'espace : videz le cache des: Free up space: clear the photo cache below, then delete unneeded files (logs, old backups).
strings.Pensez à vider le cache des photos ou à: Consider clearing the photo cache or freeing up space before the disk is full.
strings.{0} % du disque, {1} % de l'espace utili: {0} % of the disk, {1} % of the used space
strings.Supprimer les {0} photo(s) en cache ({1}: Delete the {0} cached photo(s) ({1})? They will be downloaded again if needed.
strings.Texte affiché sous la photo dans le pann: Text shown below the photo in the panel: reorder the items with the arrows, choose which to show, their size, bold and italic, and whether they share the previous item's line. The proximity alert line cannot be changed. Applied after the program restarts.
strings.Le crédit est déjà visible à l'intérieur: The credit is already visible inside the image: this line repeats it below the photo.
strings.Retour à la version précédente: Going back to the previous version
strings.Revenir à la version {0} ? L'affichage s: Go back to version {0}? The display will be restarted, then webadmin will restart.
strings.Version précédente introuvable dans le d: Previous version not found in the local repository.
strings.Le retour à la version précédente a écho: Going back to the previous version failed.
strings.Retour à la version précédente terminé :: Rollback complete: webadmin is now running {0}.
strings.Stable : seulement les versions publiées: Stable: only published versions (v1.2.0…), safer. Development: every new commit, including those not published yet.
strings.Exporte la configuration du Raspberry Pi: Exports the Raspberry Pi configuration to a file, and restores it (for example on a new SD card after a failure).
strings.Inclure les mots de passe et la clé CART: Include passwords and the CARTO key
strings.Nécessaire pour tout retrouver après une: Needed to get everything back after a failure. The file then contains secrets: do not share it and keep it somewhere safe.
strings.Remplace la configuration actuelle (l'an: Replaces the current configuration (the old one is kept as config.ini.bak). A backup without secrets keeps those of this installation.
strings.Restaurer la configuration depuis « {0}: Restore the configuration from "{0}"? The current settings will be replaced.
strings.Chaque type d'avion (code ICAO) est asso: Each aircraft type (ICAO code) is linked to an icon shape. Tap a type to change its icon, or add a missing type. Applied after the program restarts.
Each aircraft type (ICAO code) is linked to an icon shape. Tap a type to see its details and change its icon. Applied after the program restarts.
strings.Pas encore vu au-dessus de chez vous: Not seen above your home yet
strings.Fiche sur internet ↗: Look it up on the web ↗
strings.En vert : types déjà vus au-dessus de ch: In green: types already seen above your home (hover to see how many times).
strings.Vos changements sont enregistrés tout de: Your changes are saved immediately. Restart the program to see them on the display.
strings.Type introuvable dans la base OACI: Type not found in the ICAO database
strings.La sauvegarde contient config.ini (régla: The backup contains config.ini (settings, with or without the secrets), the aircraft type list, the sound state and the map already built (background.png and map_meta.json). Photos are not included.
strings.Le programme d'affichage n'est pas conce: The display program is not affected by this update: it keeps running without interruption.
strings.non concerné par cette mise à jour : pas: not affected by this update: no restart
strings.Rechercher une adresse ou un lieu: Search an address or a place
strings.Cet aperçu montre la même zone que la ca: This preview shows the same area as the rebuilt map, on a darkened OpenStreetMap background. The background actually displayed will be CARTO's (roads, water, runways and place names), built when the map is rebuilt.
Pick a position on the map.
strings.Zone affichée : {0} km × {1} km (ratio {: Displayed area: {0} km × {1} km (ratio {2}, {3} m per pixel).
strings.La carte n'a pas pu être chargée (accès: The map could not be loaded (this browser needs internet access). You can still type the values in the fields below.
strings.pygame (LGPL), requests (Apache 2.0), Pi: pygame (LGPL), requests (Apache 2.0), Pillow (MIT-CMU), paho-mqtt (EPL 2.0 or BSD 3-Clause), DejaVu fonts. In webadmin: Leaflet (BSD 2-Clause), for the position picker map.
strings.Personnalisez le fond de carte : thème,: Customize the base map: theme, displayed elements, colors and place names. The preview is drawn by the same program as the map. Then save and rebuild the map.
strings.Aperçu réel : il est dessiné par le même: Real preview: it is drawn by the same program as the map, for the area and ratio of the Map and position page (including unsaved changes). Fonts may differ slightly.
strings.Par défaut, les couleurs du thème choisi: By default, the colors of the chosen theme. A color changed here replaces the theme's; choosing another theme resets them.
strings.Les noms de lieux, les routes et les aut: Place names, roads and the other elements come from the CARTO vector base map. On a light background, yellow aircraft stand out less: prefer a dark theme for a display readable from afar.
strings.L'aperçu n'a pas pu être généré :: The preview could not be generated:
strings.L'aperçu a pris trop de temps (réseau le: The preview took too long (slow network?).
strings.La clé API CARTO n'est pas renseignée (C: The CARTO API key is not set (Map and position, Base map): the preview needs it.
strings.une construction de la carte ou une mise: a map build or an update is in progress
strings.un aperçu est déjà en cours de génératio: a preview is already being generated
strings.L'avion dont la photo est montrée dans l: The aircraft whose photo is shown in the panel.
strings.Types absents de la liste (voir Types d': Types missing from the list (see Aircraft types).
strings.Les réglages ont changé : l'aperçu affic: Settings have changed: the displayed preview is out of date.
strings.Cliquez sur la carte ou faites glisser l: Click the map or drag the marker to set your position. The yellow rectangle is the area the program will display; the gray circles are the distance circles. The values are written in the fields below; then save and rebuild the map.
strings.Cercles centrés sur votre position, trac: Circles centered on your position, drawn by the program (no need to rebuild the map).
strings.Seuls les cercles contenus dans la haute: Only circles that fit within the map height are drawn.
strings.Peut aussi servir de distance d'alerte (: Can also be used as the alert distance (Proximity alert).
strings.Afficher la distance sur chaque cercle: Show the distance on each circle
strings.Petit texte « 5 km » au sommet du cercle: Small "5 km" text at the top of the circle.
strings.Utiliser la distance du premier cercle: Use the distance of the first circle
strings.Le rayon d'alerte prend la distance du p: The alert radius takes the distance of the first circle (Map and position, Distance circles). Turn off to set another distance.
strings.0 désactive toute l'alerte. Ignoré quand: 0 turns the whole alert off. Ignored when the distance of the first circle is used (option below).
strings.Cette version n'est pas une version de s: This version is not a fallback version.
